title: CWG2: further guide to PAYE and National Insurance contributions
text:
This guide covers how you deal with PAYE and National Insurance contributions in some less common situations.

 You can find previous versions of the guide on the National Archives website .
changeNote: HTML document ‘2026 to 2027: Employer further guide to PAYE and National Insurance contributions’ has been updated in section 5.4.2 to reflect the new 'car or van' hire rate from 44 percent per mile to 55 percent per mile,
